title: Project Update
text: The team is facing delays in delivery because the project timeline was underestimated. The main issue is inconsistent communication between design and engineering. Scheduling problems are also affecting the launch plan. Customers reported confusion during onboarding because the instructions were not clear. The team plans to simplify the process and improve documentation before the next release.

title: Customer Feedback
text: Customers say the interface is easy to use but the setup requires too many steps. Several people mentioned confusion around pricing and account setup. Support responses are generally helpful, but response times are slower during peak hours. Users want clearer onboarding instructions and faster troubleshooting.

title: Research Notes
text: The study shows that users respond better to short tutorials than long manuals. The strongest pattern is that people need clearer explanations of features and pricing. More feedback is needed before making final recommendations. The team plans to test a simplified onboarding flow in the next study cycle.
